negative:
- region "Notifications alt+T"
- link "Skip to results":
  - /url: "#results"
- banner:
  - paragraph: Solo Revenue Planner
  - heading "How many customers cover your costs, and how much work is left?" [level=1]
  - paragraph: A calculator for a software business you intend to run alone. Enter your assumptions and see the break-even customer count, the surplus those assumptions produce, and the human hours that remain.
  - paragraph: Illustrative scenario built from the assumptions you typed. Not an observed result, not a forecast and not financial advice. Taxes and one-off setup costs are excluded from this simple model.
- main:
  - heading "Your assumptions" [level=2]
  - region "Per-customer economics":
    - heading "Per-customer economics" [level=2]
    - paragraph: What one customer pays you, and what one customer costs you.
    - generic: Price per customer per month
    - paragraph: What one customer pays you each month.
    - textbox "Price per customer per month": "-1"
    - generic: USD
    - alert:
      - generic: Price per customer per month cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: Variable cost per customer per month
    - paragraph: Hosting, API calls and anything that grows with each extra customer.
    - textbox "Variable cost per customer per month": "-1"
    - generic: USD
    - alert:
      - generic: Variable cost per customer per month cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: Payment processing fee
    - paragraph: Share of gross revenue kept by your payment processor.
    - textbox "Payment processing fee": "-1"
    - generic: "% of revenue"
    - alert:
      - generic: Payment processing fee cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
  - region "Fixed costs and scale":
    - heading "Fixed costs and scale" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Costs that stay flat, and how many customers you are assuming.
    - generic: Fixed monthly costs
    - paragraph: "Costs you pay whatever the customer count is: tools, domains, subscriptions."
    - textbox "Fixed monthly costs": "-1"
    - generic: USD
    - alert:
      - generic: Fixed monthly costs cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: Customer count
    - paragraph: Paying customers in the month. Whole numbers only.
    - textbox "Customer count": "-1"
    - generic: customers
    - alert:
      - generic: Customer count cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
  - region "Human work left over":
    - heading "Human work left over" [level=2]
    - paragraph: The hours a person still has to put in, and what those hours are worth.
    - generic: Human support minutes per customer per month
    - paragraph: Hands-on minutes each customer needs from you every month.
    - textbox "Human support minutes per customer per month": "-1"
    - generic: minutes
    - alert:
      - generic: Human support minutes per customer per month cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: Fixed human hours per month
    - paragraph: "Hours you spend regardless of customer count: maintenance, admin, updates."
    - textbox "Fixed human hours per month": "-1"
    - generic: hours
    - alert:
      - generic: Fixed human hours per month cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: Value of your time per hour
    - paragraph: What one hour of your own work is worth to you. Used only for economic surplus.
    - textbox "Value of your time per hour" [active]: "-1"
    - generic: USD / hour
    - alert:
      - generic: Value of your time per hour cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
  - heading "Scenario data" [level=3]
  - button "Download scenario JSON" [disabled]:
    - text: Download scenario JSON
  - button "Reset to sample inputs":
    - text: Reset to sample inputs
  - paragraph: Export is disabled until every assumption is valid, so an export can never contain a fabricated result.
  - paragraph
  - paragraph:
    - text: Your assumptions are saved in this browser only, using local storage under the key
    - code: solo-revenue-planner:scenario:v1
    - text: ", so the page remembers them when you return. Reset deletes that saved copy."
  - paragraph:
    - generic: Nothing you type is sent anywhere. There is no server, no account, no analytics, no tracker, no contact form and no external AI call. The export file is generated in this tab.
- region "Results unavailable":
  - heading "Results unavailable" [level=2]:
    - text: Results unavailable
  - paragraph: Nothing is calculated while an assumption is invalid, because a made-up number would be worse than no number. Fix the fields below and the results appear immediately.
  - list:
    - generic: "Price per customer per month:"
    - text: Price per customer per month cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: "Variable cost per customer per month:"
    - text: Variable cost per customer per month cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: "Payment processing fee:"
    - text: Payment processing fee cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: "Fixed monthly costs:"
    - text: Fixed monthly costs cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: "Customer count:"
    - text: Customer count cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: "Human support minutes per customer per month:"
    - text: Human support minutes per customer per month cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: "Fixed human hours per month:"
    - text: Fixed human hours per month cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
    - generic: "Value of your time per hour:"
    - text: Value of your time per hour cannot be negative. Enter 0 or more.
- region "What this tool can and cannot tell you":
  - heading "What this tool can and cannot tell you" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Read this before trusting any figure above.
  - generic "What is this tool actually doing?":
    - generic: What is this tool actually doing?
  - generic "Can it tell me whether anyone will pay this price?":
    - generic: Can it tell me whether anyone will pay this price?
  - generic "Does it account for what it costs to find customers?":
    - generic: Does it account for what it costs to find customers?
  - generic "What about churn?":
    - generic: What about churn?
  - generic "Can AI agents run the human work for me?":
    - generic: Can AI agents run the human work for me?
  - generic "Why are there two surplus numbers?":
    - generic: Why are there two surplus numbers?
  - generic "Why does break-even sometimes disappear?":
    - generic: Why does break-even sometimes disappear?
  - generic "What is deliberately left out?":
    - generic: What is deliberately left out?
